items.title: Do LLM Valuation Agents Read the Filing? Metamorphic Tests of Filing Fidelity on Korean Listed Firms
items.claim: Even with arithmetic delegated to Python, none of four preregistered primary hypotheses survives Holm correction across 150 Korean firms.

items.title: Look-ahead index membership and the relative accuracy of stock forecast
items.claim: Look-ahead index rosters bias forecast comparisons against ML models, shrinking the Nasdaq-100 ML advantage over small size by about 90%.

items.title: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems
items.claim: External outcome feedback can constrain claims about a trading system's returns but cannot identify which evolving procedure produced them without provenance binding.
